interface.shortDescription: Governance doctrine for agentic AI. Validate your builds against reviewable, auditable standards.
interface.longDescription: Public agentic AI doctrine tools plus authenticated architecture, design, and spec validators. The doctrine tools (principles, clusters, examples, guides) work without an account. The validators (architect.validate, design.validate, spec.validate) need a signed-in AI Design Blueprint account with an active Pro, Pro Plus, Teams, or beta plan.
